models_evaluated: DLRN (PyRadiomics + ResNet101 deep learning radiomics nomogram)

links.outcome: Model AUC for muscle invasion across internal and external multi-center validation cohorts
links.effect: DLRN AUC 0.807 in internal validation and 0.783 in external multi-center validation; patients stratified into risk groups for OS, showing generalizability across diverse clinical settings.
links.quote: The DL radiomics nomogram (DLRN) model demonstrated superior diagnostic performance, achieving an AUC of 0.807 in the internal validation cohort and 0.783 in the external multi-center validation cohort for predicting muscle invasion.

links.outcome: Urologist diagnostic sensitivity and accuracy with versus without AI assistance
links.effect: AI-assisted diagnostics significantly improved the sensitivity and accuracy of urologists, particularly among less experienced clinicians.
links.quote: AI-assisted diagnostics significantly improved the sensitivity and accuracy of urologists, particularly among less experienced clinicians.

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing diagnostic sensitivity and accuracy of urologists with and without AI assistance.
